ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there is a horizontal base, the left end connects to a vertical side and is marked with a right angle; from the upper-left vertex a slanted line is drawn to an intermediate point on the horizontal base, and there is another longer slanted line connected to the right end. At the intermediate base intersection, the angle formed by the left side of the slanted line and the horizontal base is labeled 29°, and the adjacent angle on the right side of the slanted line is labeled ∠2. Reasoning: At this intermediate base intersection, the 29° angle and ∠2 share the slanted side, and the other sides are respectively the two opposite rays of the horizontal straight line to the left and to the right, so they form a linear pair and their sum is 180°. Therefore m∠2 = 180° - 29° = 151°.
